arxiv-2105-02193.title: Follow-up spectroscopy of comet C/2020 F3 (NEOWISE) Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2105-02193.creator: Richard Bischoff* and Markus Mugrauer
arxiv-2105-02193.description: Abstract We present spectroscopy of the coma center of comet C/2020 F3 (NEOWISE), carried out at the end of July 2020 with the Échelle spectrograph FLECHAS at the University Observatory Jena. The comet was observed in 5 nights and many prominent emission features were detected between 4685 Å and 7376 Å.

arxiv-2412-08653.title: What AI evaluations for preventing catastrophic risks can and cannot do
arxiv-2412-08653.creator: Peter Barnett Lisa Thiergart
arxiv-2412-08653.description: Abstract AI evaluations are an important component of the AI governance toolkit, underlying current approaches to safety cases for preventing catastrophic risks. Our paper examines what these evaluations can and cannot tell us. Evaluations can establish lower bounds on AI capabilities and assess certain misuse risks given sufficient effort from evaluators.

arxiv-2508-07120.title: Low Cost Bayesian Experimental Design for Quantum Frequency Estimation with Decoherence
arxiv-2508-07120.creator: Alexandra Ramôa, Luís Paulo Santos, Akihito Soeda
arxiv-2508-07120.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Frequency estimation is a crucial task in quantum metrology. It underpins the understanding of physical phenomena such as Larmor [ 27 ] , Rabi [ 29 ] and Ramsey [ 36 ] oscillations. Applications include calibration of superconducting qubits and magnetic field sensing [ 38 , 2 , 33 ] .

arxiv-2508-18380.title: Information Templates: A New Paradigm for Intelligent Active Feature Acquisition
arxiv-2508-18380.creator: Hung-Tien Huang, Dzung Dinh, Junier B. Oliva
arxiv-2508-18380.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hung-Tien Huang, Dzung Dinh, Junier B. Oliva. Active feature acquisition (AFA) is an instance-adaptive paradigm in which, at test time, a policy sequentially chooses which features to acquire (at a cost) before predicting. Existing approaches either train reinforcement learning (RL) policies, which deal with a difficult MDP, or greedy policies that cannot account for the joint informativeness of features or require knowledge about the underlying data distribution.

arxiv-2511-09748.title: How Small Can You Go? Compact Language Models for On-Device Critical Error Detection in Machine Translation Thanks: This research has been funded by the Federal Ministry of Education and Research of Germany and the state of North-Rhine Westphalia as part of the Lamarr Institute for Machine Learning

arxiv-2511-09748.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at evaluating machine translation (MT), but their scale and cost hinder deployment on edge devices and in privacy-sensitive workflows. We ask: how small can you get while still detecting meaning-altering translation errors? Focusing on English→German Critical Error Detection (CED), we benchmark sub-2 B models (LFM2-350M, Qwen-3 0.6B/1.7B, Llama-3.

britannica-1911-deccan.title: Deccan (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-deccan.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-deccan.description: Article 'Deccan' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. according to Hindu geographers, to the whole of the territories in India situated to the south of the river Nerbudda. In its more modern acceptation, however, it is sometimes understood as comprising only the country lying between that river and the Kistna, the latter having for a long period formed the southern boundary of the Mahommedan empire of Delhi.

pmc-10536908.title: An Improved YOLOv5 Algorithm for Vulnerable Road User Detection
pmc-10536908.creator: Wei Yang, Xiaolin Tang, Kongming Jiang, Yang Fu, Xinling Zhang
pmc-10536908.description: The vulnerable road users (VRUs), being small and exhibiting random movements, increase the difficulty of object detection of the autonomous emergency braking system for vulnerable road users AEBS-VRUs, with their behaviors highly random. To overcome existing problems of AEBS-VRU object detection, an enhanced YOLOv5 algorithm is proposed.

pmc-10660241.title: Physician- and Patient-Elicited Barriers and Facilitators to Implementation of a Machine Learning–Based Screening Tool for Peripheral Arterial Disease: Preimplementation Study With Physician and Patient Stakeholders
pmc-10660241.creator: Vy Ho, Cati Brown Johnson, Ilies Ghanzouri, Saeed Amal, Steven Asch, Elsie Ross
pmc-10660241.description: BackgroundPeripheral arterial disease (PAD) is underdiagnosed, partially due to a high prevalence of atypical symptoms and a lack of physician and patient awareness. Implementing clinical decision support tools powered by machine learning algorithms may help physicians identify high-risk patients for diagnostic workup.

pmc-10674288.title: Network Pharmacology, Molecular Docking, and Molecular Dynamics Simulation to Elucidate the Molecular Targets and Potential Mechanism of Phoenix dactylifera (Ajwa Dates) against Candidiasis
pmc-10674288.creator: Mohd Adnan, Arif Jamal Siddiqui, Syed Amir Ashraf, Fevzi Bardakci, Mousa Alreshidi, Riadh Badraoui, Emira Noumi, Bektas Tepe, Manojkumar Sachidanandan, Mitesh Patel
pmc-10674288.description: Candidiasis, caused by opportunistic fungal pathogens of the Candida genus, poses a significant threat to immunocompromised individuals. Natural compounds derived from medicinal plants have gained attention as potential sources of anti-fungal agents. Ajwa dates (Phoenix dactylifera L.) have been recognized for their diverse phytochemical composition and therapeutic potential.

pmc-11475464.title: Why partisans feel hated: Distinct static and dynamic relationships with animosity meta-perceptions
pmc-11475464.creator: Jeffrey Lees, Mina Cikara, James N Druckman, Eugen Dimant
pmc-11475464.description: Partisans hold inaccurate perceptions of the other side. What drives these inaccuracies? We address this question with a focus on partisan animosity meta-perceptions (i.e. how much a partisan believes opposing partisans hate them). We argue that predictors can relate to meta-perceptions statically (e.g.

pmc-11505161.title: Parent–Child Relationships and Adolescents’ Non-Cognitive Skills: Role of Social Anxiety and Number of Friends
pmc-11505161.creator: Xiaoxue Kuang, Fen Ren, John Chi-Kin Lee, Hui Li, Tour Liu, Tao Xin
pmc-11505161.description: This study aimed to examine the association between parent–child relationships and adolescents’ non-cognitive skills, while also investigating the mediating effect of social anxiety and number of friends. A survey was conducted with 773 students, ranging from grade 4 to 9, in five public schools of Guangdong Province of China (49.9% male), with a mean age of 12.20 years old.

pmc-11567121.title: Cryptosporidium spp. in German wildlife: Detection, regional occurrence and diversity in wild boar, roe, red and fallow deer
pmc-11567121.creator: Claudia Jäckel, Iryna Hrushetska, Anne Mayer-Scholl, Jens A. Hammerl, Annette Johne, Carl Gremse, Denny Maaz, Karsten Nöckler, Martin Heinrich Richter
pmc-11567121.description: Cryptosporidium is a cause of diarrheal infections responsible for a loss of human and animal welfare worldwide. The impact of the parasite is underestimated and the reported sources of infection are diverse, as it occurs in a wide variety of hosts.

pmc-11621665.title: Ultra-Processed Foods and the Impact on Cardiometabolic Health: The Role of Diet Quality
pmc-11621665.creator: Xiaowen Wang, Qi Sun
pmc-11621665.description: The consumption of ultra-processed foods (UPFs) has surged globally, raising significant public health concerns due to their associations with a range of adverse health outcomes. This review aims to elucidate potential health impacts of UPF intake and underscore the importance of considering diet quality when interpreting study findings.

pmc-12429996.title: Influence of Plasma Assistance on EB-PVD TBC Coating Thickness Distribution and Morphology
pmc-12429996.creator: Grzegorz Maciaszek, Krzysztof Cioch, Andrzej Nowotnik, Damian Nabel, Nicola Calisi, Stefano Mauro Martinuzzi
pmc-12429996.description: In this study, the effects of plasma assistance on the electron beam physical vapour deposition (EB-PVD) process were investigated using an industrial coater (Smart Coater ALD Vacuum Technologies GmbH) equipped with a dual hollow cathode system. This configuration enabled the generation of a plasma environment during the deposition of the ceramic top coat onto a metallic substrate.

pmc-12563715.title: Impact of Delayed Trauma Unit Admission on Mortality and Disability in Traumatic Brain Injury Patients
pmc-12563715.creator: Julio Quispe-Alcocer, Antonio Biroli, Fabricio González-Andrade
pmc-12563715.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) remains a critical public health issue worldwide, with significant morbidity, mortality, and long-term disability. Timely transfer to a specialized trauma unit is crucial to improving outcomes, yet in resource-limited settings, delays often exceed recommended time frames. This study evaluates the impact of arrival time on mortality, disability, and clinical outcomes in Ecuadorian patients with TBI.

pmc-12615027.title: Pilot Study of Early Adoption of Automated Insulin Delivery in Underresourced Youth
pmc-12615027.creator: Kevin Yen, Sonali Belapurkar, Cassidy Puckett, Natalie S. Chen, Loren Yglecias, Kavenpreet S. Bal, Jeannie G. Hickey, Lois L. Carelli, Crystal M. Loucel, Maya Lodish, Jenise C. Wong
pmc-12615027.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDisparities in outcomes and technology use in children with Type 1 diabetes (T1D) from underresourced backgrounds are well documented. The feasibility of initiating automated insulin delivery (AID) soon after diagnosis of T1D is less certain in this population. This pilot study assessed the feasibility and acceptability of providing access to the Tandem Control-IQ AID system to children with public insurance soon after T1D diagnosis.MethodsPublicly insured children aged 6–21 years of age within 3 months of T1D diagnosis were eligible for the study.

pmc-12925645.title: Impact of US government funding freezes on the HIV response: findings from a rapid survey in 32 countries
pmc-12925645.creator: Ellen Brazier, Stephany N Duda, Jeremy Ross, Aggrey S Semeere, Thierry Tiendrebeogo, Cleophas Chimbetete, Denis Nash
pmc-12925645.description: IntroductionAfter the freezing of US foreign assistance in January 2025, the International Epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS (IeDEA) conducted a rapid survey among clinics and programs actively participating in the research consortium to assess the status of HIV-related service delivery in mid-2025.

pmc-13188685.title: Associations of plasma level of soluble LDL receptor with cardiovascular events and mortality in a large prospective cohort study
pmc-13188685.creator: Shieon Kim, Hee Ju Jun, Garam Jo, Dahyun Park, Soyoung Kwak, Min-Jeong Shin, Ronald M Krauss
pmc-13188685.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSoluble low-density lipoprotein receptor (sLDLR) is proteolytically cleaved from cell membranes and released into the circulation. Prior studies have linked plasma sLDLR to atherogenic lipids, but prospective evidence for its relation to cardiovascular outcomes is limited.

pmc-13241838.title: Shear-wave ultrasound elastography for tissue-specific quantification of radiation-induced cervical fibrosis
pmc-13241838.creator: Hendrik Dapper, Maria Waltenberger, Steffi U. Pigorsch, Stephanie E. Combs, Katharina Bauermeister, Wolfgang Bauermeister
pmc-13241838.description: Graphical abstract Introduction Fibrosis is a descriptive term for a dynamic pathological process involving damage to parenchymal cells, stromal tissue remodeling, and contraction of the affected tissue [1]. Fibrosis is a late effect of radiotherapy that rarely improves over time and persists as a chronic condition impairing a patient’s functioning and quality of life (QoL) [2], [3], [4], [5].

pmc-13267386.title: Financial literacy and psychological vulnerability to financial exploitation: the roles of financial anxiety, self-confidence, and behavior
pmc-13267386.creator: Alper Veli Çam, Şafak Sönmez Soydaş, Adem Özbek, Handan Çam
pmc-13267386.description: BackgroundFinancial exploitation constitutes a significant psychological vulnerability shaped by cognitive resources, emotional regulation, and financial decision-making behaviors. While financial literacy is widely recognized as a protective factor, limited empirical evidence disentangles the distinct psychological roles of financial knowledge, attitudes, and behaviors in reducing vulnerability to financial exploitation.MethodsThis cross-sectional study analyzed survey data from 565 adults in Türkiye.

pmc-7619551.title: Claudin-1 targeting suppresses tumor growth, invasion and metastasis in patient-derived cholangiocarcinoma models
pmc-7619551.creator: Zeina Nehme, Marion Muller, Jade Brochon, Emilie Crouchet, Frank Jühling, Mélissa Messé, Laura Heydmann, Julien Moehlin, Romain Desert, Fabio Del Zompo, Christine Thumann, Joachim Lupberger, Natascha Roehlen, Emanuele Felli, Patrick Pessaux, Aïna Venkatasamy, Patrice Marchand, Mihaela Alina Onea, Ro
pmc-7619551.description: Cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is an adenocarcinoma of the hepatobiliary system that has recently risen in incidence and mortality with unsatisfactory treatment options. Claudin-1 (CLDN1) is a transmembrane protein expressed in tight junctions and exposed on the cell surface in liver fibrosis and cancer.
